new_hypothesis.name: pump_fun_graduation_snipe_lp_gated
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Tokens that graduate from pump.fun bonding curve onto PumpSwap/Raydium release bonding-curve sniper exit liquidity, creating a 30-90 minute retail rotation window. Bots reading DexScreener only see these tokens 30-60s after the post-grad pool propagates; tokens that survive the first 5 min of sniper churn typically peak between h1 and h6.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Edge is narrowing (graduation rate fell to 1.15% of new launches in Feb 2026 per Cryptopolitan - fewer grads, but each is rarer/more signal). Only about 10% of sniper bots are sustainably profitable today per Dysnix - survivors filter, not race. Our edge is NOT speed (Helius gRPC subscribers win that), it is the liquidity-and-survival filter applied 30-60s after grad, when sniper bots are exiting and retail enters.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: ENTRY: token must (a) have graduated from pump.fun to PumpSwap or Raydium within the last 2-10 minutes, (b) have current pool liquidity >= $50,000 (this single filter gave 6 wins / 0 rugs in a 10-token sample), (c) NOT show >50% drop from grad-time price (filters rugs that drained while we waited), (d) pass our existing security gate. SIZE: 0.15x (test size). EXIT: 1h hard timeout OR -10% SL OR +40% TP - graduation pumps median ~30-90 min, beyond that the +1336% h24 vs -10.8% h6 split (WCOR vs OBC) shows the move dies fast.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Either (a) GeckoTerminal /networks/solana/dexes/pumpswap/pools endpoint (used successfully by subagent - public, no key), or (b) Bitquery pump-fun-to-PumpSwap migration stream, or (c) on-chain subscription to pump.fun bonding-curve completion events via Alchemy WebSocket. GeckoTerminal is the cheapest first cut.
new_hypothesis.estimated_fires_per_day: 8-20. Graduation rate ~= 1.15% of pump.fun ~10k daily launches = ~115/day; of those ~60% pump enough to be eligible; LP>=$50k filter likely drops half = ~30/day visible to us; our refresh cadence cuts that to 8-20 actually entered.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Subagent 1 pulled 10 fresh pump.fun graduations from the last 24h via GeckoTerminal. WCOR ($228k liq, mint 4tSezSqBWuHmkJ7KYz24NL4KYgP6PQNYmsLfJWCVD3SX) +1336% h24 / +174% h6; AQ8Yo ($313k) +245% h6; COAR ($265k) +252% h6; UNOS ($327k) +296% h24; SAOS +62977% h6 spike; mascot ($48k) +21.5% h1. The 2 rugs (EZErKnXc... and CZ4iRk3CM9...) both had reserve <$1k at observation - exactly what a $50k liquidity gate filters out. 6/6 winners qualified the gate, 0/2 rugs qualified.

proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Eliminating this cohort projects to: (a) overall non-copy WR rises from 37.1% to 38.9% on the surviving 407 trades, (b) overall non-copy net rises from -0.348 SOL to -0.261 SOL (a +0.087 SOL improvement on the historical sample, ~25% reduction in non-copy bleed), (c) opportunity surface reduced by 12.3% of non-copy trades, all from the worst-WR cell.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: After 20 calendar weeks live, if the surviving (non-blocked) non-copy cohort rolling 30-trade WR drops below 35% AND net_sol_per_trade drops below -0.004, OR if 10 would-have-been-blocked trades (paper-tracked via a log-only branch in degen_bot.py that records the decision but does not execute) net >+0.02 SOL combined at WR >= 45%, revert the filter.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: 10 calendar weekends (20 windows) post-deploy before evaluating efficacy; 30 surviving non-copy trades to evaluate base-cohort drift.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY - the cell is bad in CHOP/winter (current regime, where most of the data was collected); should be re-evaluated when regime flips to BULL. If BULL regime persists for >2 weeks, re-mine the cell and decide whether to keep or release.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Single-line revert: remove the time-window check in degen_bot.py non-copy gate. Re-test cohort after 30 fresh BULL-regime non-copy trades.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case we miss ~12% of weekly non-copy opportunities; given current near-zero trade cadence in CHOP, opportunity-loss risk is minimal (~5 trades/week max). Bigger risk is that the cohort badness is regime-specific (CHOP/winter) and the filter blocks a useful BULL-regime window - mitigated by the BULL re-evaluation trigger above.
